invariants.rationale: The method expects a list of HoodieRecord<T>, which will be used in several downstream operations; null would result in a NullPointerException.
instantTime is required by the logic to identify the operation instant; it is passed to other methods and must be non-null.
bulkInsertPartitioner is of type Option<BulkInsertPartitioner> and should not be null by usage conventions for Option types.
As per List contract, size() is always non-negative.
BulkInsertPartitioner is an Option, which is always either present or absent, capturing a basic but real Option invariant.
